Interface ISort.IFcnSort

All Superinterfaces:
INode, IPos.IPosable, ISort
All Known Implementing Classes:
Sort.FcnSort
Enclosing interface:
ISort
public static interface ISort.IFcnSort extends ISort
An interface to represent the Sort of a function; this is not something that can be written as a sort expression in SMT-LIB, but it is convenient to be able to represent the sorts of function ids uniformly with the sorts of other ids. // FIXME - perhaps we can get around this - IFcnSort
